_comment: Model profiles. Each infra/params/<env>.json picks one with "ModelProfile"; scripts/deploy.py and the eval runner expand it into stack parameters (a key set in the params file wins over the profile). Switching profiles is a release like any other: evals, smoke test and bake. Check access first with: python scripts/deploy.py check-models --env prod --model-profile <name>

target._comment: The intended setup: Claude Sonnet 5.5 writes the edition, Claude Haiku 5.5 judges it.

sonnet-4-6._comment: Interim setup while Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 are not available for this account (AWS account-level restriction; a Support case asks to lift it): Claude Sonnet 4.6 writes with adaptive thinking, Claude Haiku 4.5 judges, so the writer does not grade its own work. Global inference prices from the AWS Marketplace listings.

haiku-4-5._comment: First interim setup (Claude Haiku 4.5 writes and judges), kept as a fallback. This model takes no effort parameter and no adaptive thinking. Self-grading is lenient, so read groundedness scores as optimistic.
